parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The emotion expressed by the two animated blue eyes; no emoji or text glyphs.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love, angry, scared, playful. clear is invalid; use setExpression for persistent state or clearing.

Display.doc: Perform one eye expression, awaiting its transition and return to the current base expression. Each call is a fresh performance. Does not change captions or speech.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The emotion expressed by the two animated blue eyes; no emoji or text glyphs.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: clear, smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love, angry, scared, playful. clear resets the base to neutral.

Display.doc: Set the persistent base eye expression until replaced, cleared or reset on new user speech. Completes on state acceptance, not animation completion. Repeating the same emotion is idempotent.

Robot.doc: Perform the requested finite gesture using motors1–5, starting and ending at their home; never command or wait for the gripper. Accept optional native speed1–1400 and acceleration1–254. Stable arrival advances immediately. Stable off-target positions, send errors and missing feedback end only affected atomic steps and are collected in the final report; subsequent composition steps and Channel actions continue. Unavailable-device steps fail without blind writes, queries or replay. Explicit cancellation stops remaining work. Use only on user request with a connected arm and clear space.

function.name: runtimeInfo
function.description: Read the fixed local runtime configuration description. This is not a live health or model-readiness probe.

function.name: Camera.open
function.description: Enable foreground camera preview and vision processing. Requires camera permission and an available camera; completion confirms capture, not pose-model readiness.

function.name: Camera.close
function.description: Disable camera preview and vision processing, and wait for capture and vision cleanup.

function.name: Camera.flip
function.description: Switch the enabled foreground camera between front and rear lenses. Fails if disabled, busy or unavailable.
